---
title: TYPO3
description: Privacy rules for TYPO3 12.4, 13.4, and 14.3 on MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite
---

Covers frontend and backend users, sessions, the backend log, record locks, page authors, and the creator and location of file metadata in the TYPO3 core.

## Coverage

- **Versions:** 12.4, 13.4, 14.3 LTS; tt_address 9.1, 10.0; powermail 12.6, 13.3; femanager 8.4, 13.4. File metadata rules need the `filemetadata` system extension.
- **Engines:** MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite.
- **Table prefix:** the template assumes unprefixed table names. TYPO3 uses no table prefix.

## Template

```yaml
privacy:
  rules:
    emails:
      columns:
        - fe_users.email
        - be_users.email
        - pages.author_email
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.email
        # powermail (optional)
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.sender_mail
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.receiver_mail
      entity: EMAIL_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    names:
      columns:
        - fe_users.username
        - fe_users.name
        - fe_users.first_name
        - fe_users.middle_name
        - fe_users.last_name
        - be_users.username
        - be_users.realName
        - sys_lockedrecords.username
        - pages.author
        - sys_file_metadata.creator
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.name
        - tt_address.first_name
        - tt_address.middle_name
        - tt_address.last_name
        - tt_address.skype # 9.1 only
        - tt_address.twitter
        - tt_address.facebook
        - tt_address.instagram
        - tt_address.tiktok
        - tt_address.linkedin
        - tt_address.bluesky # 10.0+
        - tt_address.youtubechannel # 10.0+
        # powermail (optional)
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.sender_name
      entity: PERSON
      operator: hash
    phones:
      columns:
        - fe_users.telephone
        - fe_users.fax
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.phone
        - tt_address.mobile
        - tt_address.fax
        - tt_address.whatsapp # 10.0+
      entity: PHONE_NUMBER
      operator: hash
    addresses:
      columns:
        - fe_users.address
        - fe_users.city
        - sys_file_metadata.location_country
        - sys_file_metadata.location_region
        - sys_file_metadata.location_city
        - sys_file_metadata.latitude
        - sys_file_metadata.longitude
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.address
        - tt_address.building
        - tt_address.room
        - tt_address.city
        - tt_address.region
        - tt_address.latitude
        - tt_address.longitude
        # femanager (optional)
        - fe_users.state
      entity: LOCATION
      operator: hash
    postcodes:
      columns:
        - fe_users.zip
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.zip
      entity: POSTCODE
      operator: hash
    companies:
      columns:
        - fe_users.company
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.company
        - tt_address.linkedincompany # 10.0+
      entity: ORGANIZATION
      operator: hash
    birth-dates:
      columns:
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.birthday
        # femanager (optional)
        - fe_users.date_of_birth
      entity: DATE_OF_BIRTH
      operator: replace
    urls:
      columns:
        - fe_users.www
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.www
      entity: URL
      operator: replace
    ip-addresses:
      columns:
        - fe_sessions.ses_iplock
        - be_sessions.ses_iplock
        - sys_log.IP
        # powermail (optional)
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.sender_ip
      entity: IP_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    user-agents:
      columns:
        # powermail (optional)
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.user_agent
      entity: USER_AGENT
      operator: hash
    text:
      columns:
        - fe_users.description
        - be_users.description
        # System extensions (optional)
        - sys_note.subject
        - sys_note.message
        # tt_address (optional)
        - tt_address.description
        # powermail (optional)
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.body
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.subject
      entity: FREE_TEXT
      operator: replace
    passwords:
      columns:
        - fe_users.password
        - be_users.password
      entity: PASSWORD_HASH
      operator: redact
    tokens:
      columns:
        - be_users.password_reset_token
        # System extensions (optional)
        - fe_users.felogin_forgotHash
        - sys_preview.keyword
      entity: AUTH_TOKEN
      operator: redact
    secrets:
      columns:
        # System extensions (optional)
        - sys_reaction.secret
        - sys_webhook.secret
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:
      columns:
        - sys_log.log_data
        - sys_log.data
        - sys_history.history_data
        - be_users.uc
        - fe_users.uc
        - be_users.user_settings # 14.3+
        - sys_messenger_messages.body
        # powermail (optional)
        - tx_powermail_domain_model_answer.value
        # femanager (optional)
        - fe_users.tx_femanager_changerequest
        - tx_femanager_domain_model_log.additional_properties
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: replace
    # Keep: mixed-content columns that hold credentials.
    mixed-content-secrets:
      columns:
        - be_users.mfa
        - fe_users.mfa
        - be_sessions.ses_data
        - fe_sessions.ses_data
        - sys_webhook.additional_headers
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: redact
```

**Choices**

- `pages.author`, `pages.author_email`: the editor responsible for a page, staff data often printed in page metadata.
- `ses_iplock`: the client IP or its first octets; with IP locking off it holds `[DISABLED]`, which also comes back as a token.
- `latitude`, `longitude`: decimals ruled as `LOCATION`; they come back as text tokens. `be_users.mfa`, `fe_users.mfa` hold TOTP secrets.
- Optional parts: delete the commented columns of extensions you do not run ([tt_address](https://github.com/FriendsOfTYPO3/tt_address), [powermail](https://github.com/einpraegsam/powermail), [femanager](https://github.com/in2code-de/femanager)), and the `mixed-content` rule to keep those columns readable; keep `mixed-content-secrets` (MFA secrets, session data).
- powermail and femanager have no release for TYPO3 14 yet.
- `sys_preview.keyword` is the token in workspace preview links.

<Callout type="warn">
Without the `mixed-content` rule, every submitted powermail form value stays readable in `tx_powermail_domain_model_answer.value`.
</Callout>

## Trade-offs

- **Indexed ruled columns:** `fe_users.username`, `be_users.username`, `fe_users.felogin_forgotHash`, `sys_preview.keyword`, `tt_address.email`.
- **Lookups that stop working:** finding a user by username or e-mail, counting log entries per IP, finding a form submission by sender. Empty `''` values come back as tokens too.
- **Join keys that stay unruled:** `uid` and `pid` on every table, plus `ses_userid`, `sys_log.userid`, and `sys_file_metadata.file`.
- **Shared copies:** without the `mixed-content` rules, `sys_history.history_data` and `sys_log.log_data` repeat ruled values, such as an edited user's e-mail.

## Not covered

- `fe_users.title`, `country`; tt_address `title`, `position`, `gender`, `country`: coarse, left readable.
- `sys_log.details`, `sys_log.message`: placeholder templates; values sit in `log_data`.
- `sys_file_metadata.publisher`, `source`, `copyright`, `caption`, `description`: editorial text that can name photographers.
- `sys_http_report.meta`, `details`: CSP reports with anonymized IP, user agent, URLs.
- `index_stat_word.word`: visitor search terms without a user reference.
- `tx_powermail_domain_model_mail.marketing_*`: browser data, no matching data type.
